Frequently asked questions What data types and connectors work with the Data Hub? Our current connector library includes those below, but we can easily provide data connectors to any mobility providers: VivaCity Floating Vehicle Data (e.g. INRIX, TomTom) OneNetwork Modelling Tools (e.g. PTV, Immense) UTMC Tools (e.g. Yunex, Dynniq) FLIR Network Rail TagMaster SWARCO BODS and bus operator feeds National Highways Micro-mobility providers (e.g. VOI) Can't see what you need on the list? Reach out, as it is likely to be in our pipeline for deployment. How can I procure the Data Hub? Alchera Data Hub is on G-Cloud 15 for public sector procurement. Alternatively, Alchera works in the supply chain of many Tier 1 advisory and engineering firms. Reach out to find out more, and see if procurement via an existing framework is preferable. Alchera can provide terms & licence agreements for private businesses. Does the Data Hub integrate with my existing apps, tools and other software platforms? Yes. The Data Hub has been designed to operate alongside other software tools, from customer-facing apps to transport modelling tools or network management. The Data Hub can also co-exist within broader data lake architectures. Do you monitor data quality in the Data Hub? Yes. Data making its way into the data hub will be monitored for quality and cleaned. We will alert you to any anomalous activity - such as a sensor going offline - so that you can hold your suppliers to account. Is there a limit to data storage or number of users? Alchera operates a fair use policy on data volume and user numbers. We want to unlock the use of data in decision making for your teams, consultants and 3rd parties, and so encourage new users onto the platform free of charge. How long does it take to get started with the Data Hub? From commissioning, we will have your first users gaining value from the platform within 2 weeks. Can I manage how users access data? Your admin users will have the ability to manage data access per user. This means you can share selected sets of data to groups - for example sharing only your signals data to a 3rd party consultant to feed their analysis. Can I integrate historical data? What about future data sources? Yes. At set up, we will audit your data landscape, and ingest the high-priority, high value historical data sets you need for your use cases. Alchera is committed to building new connectors at no extra cost to the ongoing license fee, where there is clear benefit to delivering specific outcomes for you. Are you ready? Frequently asked questions Does this fulfil Department for Transport reporting requirements? Yes. Alchera Bus provides ready made reporting to satisfy the key KPIs required for DfT, plus a range of additional insights which will help you run your network more effectively. Do you work with bus operators? Yes. Alchera can ingest data directly from bus operators, such as patronage and ticketing data. Furthermore information can be shared back to the operators, by granting access to the Alchera Bus solution at the discretion of the local authority. How do I procure Alchera Bus? Alchera Bus is available on G-Cloud for public sector procurement. Alternatively, Alchera works in the supply chain of many Tier 1 advisory and engineering firms. Reach out to find out more, about our partners, to if procurement via the supply chain of an existing framework is preferable. Alchera can provide terms & licence agreements for private businesses. How long does it take to get started with Alchera Bus? From commissioning, we will have your first users gaining value from the platform within 2 weeks. How granular is the data - minutes or weeks? Metres or miles? Data granularity ranges depending on the KPI you are looking into. Typically, we have spatial granularity down to 20m chunks of road, and temporal granularity down to minute-by-minute and hour-by-hour reporting. Can I look beyond junctions, to links and corridors? Yes, analytics focus from junction level information all the way to user-defined corridor exploration, to make it easy to see the impact of interventions on key routes. What data do we need to get started? Alchera Bus can be deployed in any region, starting immediately using open BODS data. Through significant validated analytics, we clean and enhance BODS data in real time to ensure KPIs are reported accurately. Additional benefits come from direct bus operator integration, which we can migrate to whenever you're ready. Are you ready?
